reason: CI fails because clang_linux-riscv64=21 and clangxx_linux-riscv64=21 do not yet exist in the conda-forge channel. This is a missing upstream dependency (compiler packages), not a build bug in the feedstock. The maintainer comment from 2026-08-20 confirms the blocking dependency chain: ctng-compilers -> compiler-rt -> llvmdev -> libxml2 must land first. The linux_ppc64le_ failure is also related to the same missing cross-compiler packages.
